messages:
Sasha: Noticed the dashboard p95/p99 for /v1/generate suddenly diverged from our raw traces this morning. p95 on the dashboard dropped but traces show tail getting worse. anyone else see this?
Mike: saw a brief spike in raw logs, but dashboard looked fine from 03:00-03:20. guessing a rollup window/merge artifact.
Devin: could be the sample origin mix again — are we mixing router-sampled TTL with runtime-sampled traces? that flips percentiles if weights differ.
Sasha: exactly my thought. dashboard is using the rollup index (sample-weighted) while the trace view is pure logs. need to confirm provenance labels.
Paul: routing note: we did a tiny canary yesterday that routes 5% through the new kv-cache host. It returns faster on hits, slower on cold misses. if dashboard aggregated without origin tags the p50 could move and p99 could still be bad.
Devin: can you paste the query the dashboard runs? I want to compare sources.
Sasha: here it is from the panel config:
```sql
-- rollup query used by latency panels
SELECT p50(latency) AS p50, p95(latency) AS p95, p99(latency) AS p99
FROM endpoint_rollups
WHERE endpoint='/v1/generate' AND window=5m
GROUP BY route
```
Devin: aha — no provenance filter. that groups router+runtime+kvcache. weight mixing will hide tail.
Mike: quick fix idea: add a provenance toggle in the console (origin: router/runtime/kvcache) and default to showing 'runtime' for p95/p99. UX wise we should surface that toggle near percentile selector.
Sasha: agree. also add a small tooltip: "Percentiles reflect selected origin; rollup weights may differ from raw trace counts."
Paul: operational: i'll add a temporary annotation on the dash noting the canary and kv-cache flip, and tag the time range. deploy-bot: annotate? :deploy:
deploy-bot: annotation created for 2026-03-20 03:05 UTC - kv-cache canary (5%).
Devin: for the backend, we should expose sample_count per percentile bucket in the rollup so users can see when counts are low. also record rollup_sample_origin as a series label.
Mike: i'll open a tiny UI ticket for the toggle + tooltip and a backend ticket for sample_count/origin labels. assign: me (UI) and Devin (rollup metadata).
Sasha: thanks. one more ask — can we change default aggregator to show separate stacked lines for p50/p95/p99 per origin (collapsed by default) to avoid confusion when origin mixing exists?
Mike: yes, will prototype. Devin: will you check that adding origin metadata will not bloat rollups too much?
Devin: will verify. if storage impact is too high we can add an on-demand provenance rollup endpoint.
Paul: leaving a note: quota routing might affect sample rates for low-tier accounts, so when toggling origins consoles should show sample_rate and quota scope.
Sasha: great point — add sample_rate and quota_scope to the tooltip too.
Mike: created UI: ENGPLAT-2389, backend: ENGPLAT-2390. linking both in the ticket thread. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Sasha: resolving for now; will reopen if we see more incoherent pctl signals.
